I think a great feature to add to voat would be the ability to submit or comment anonymously. This could be an important feature for subverses where sensitive material might be discussed and someone might not want to have a username attached to it. This would also get rid of the need to create throwaway accounts that will only be used once or twice. Perhaps there could be a little button on the submitting page that asks if you want to submit anonymously or if you want to comment anonymously there could be a button asking you if you would like to enable anonymity (like this). The ability to be anonymous can also help push for more creative and original content as people aren't submitting content that will be associated with their username but rather just focus on the content/for the fun of it.
Subverses can be anonymous, but voting is disabled. If user's chose to post anonymously I think voting for that post would also need to be disabled.
Subverses can be made anonymous. I don't see much benefit to allowing individual comments to be made anonymous, though. Much more open to being expolited to attack someone.

The only thing with the comments I was thinking was that if people were discussing something that they feel would effect them by having a name associated to it. Such as a person asking for advise or wanting to talk about something traumatic that happened in their life that society has a negative view towards. It could open up the discussion in subverses that deal with confessions or something they just want to talk about without an identity. Maybe a person wants to come out but people know their username or other situations like that.
I know /v/anon is an anonymous-only sub, and I seem to recall discussion of some others.
